topic: Fundamental Constants and Mathematical Structure in Turbulence
target_audience: Advanced Undergraduate Physics or Engineering Students

sections.title: Introduction: The Chaos in the Coffee Cup
lecture_lines: Turbulence is a complex energy cascade.
Large swirls break into smaller ones.
Reynolds number defines inertial versus viscous forces.

Fade in a turbulent fluid representation (conceptual) with #3498DB color.
Highlight individual eddies emerging in the fluid flow.
Animate a zoom-in on one large, swirling eddy inside [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cup.svg].
Fade out the fluid flow and show the title again with #FFFFFF color.

sections.title: Kolmogorov’s Hypothesis: The Universal Constant
lecture_lines: K41 theory reveals a universal constant.
The inertial subrange follows a power-law.
Energy spectrum slope is negative five-thirds.
animations: Display title: 'Kolmogorov’s Hypothesis: The Universal Constant' with #FFFFFF color.
Show the Kolmogorov energy spectrum formula: E(k) = C * epsilon^(2/3) * k^(-5/3) with #FF5733 color.
Use an arrow (#2ECC71 color, scale 1.0) to point to the -5/3 exponent.
Highlight the 'C' constant as the universal parameter.
Display a plot showing the energy cascade range on a log-log scale. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]

sections.title: The Dissipation Scale: Where Chaos Ends
lecture_lines: Kinetic energy dissipates at microscopic scales.
This occurs at the Kolmogorov length scale.
Viscous forces convert motion into thermal heat.
animations: Display title: 'The Dissipation Scale: Where Chaos Ends' with #FFFFFF color.
Show the Kolmogorov length scale: eta = (nu^3 / epsilon)^(1/4) with #FF5733 color.
Animate the transition from large eddies breaking into smaller ones.

Flash the dissipation scale mark as the point where energy heat occurs [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/heater.svg] and temperature is measured [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/thermometer.svg].
Fade to black after showing the limit of turbulence.

sections.title: The Mathematical Structure: The Energy Cascade
lecture_lines: Energy cascades from injection to dissipation.
The energy transfer rate remains constant.
animations: Display title: 'The Mathematical Structure: The Energy Cascade' with #FFFFFF color [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].
Show a cascading series of squares representing energy transfer.
Label large squares as 'Large Eddies' and small as 'Small Eddies'.

sections.title: Summary and Conclusion
lecture_lines: Aerodynamics and weather follow self-similar patterns.
